VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence is insufficient to confirm criterion (1). The CI log shows 47 tests pass, but there's no evidence that any test actually covers the rounding drift bug—a passing suite could simply mean no test exercises the netting drift scenario. The self-report mentions "a small guard" but provides no code diff showing what was changed or a new/failing-then-passing test demonstrating the fix addresses the specific rounding drift. Criterion (2) appears satisfied (no dependency changes), but without proof the actual bug is fixed, BOTH criteria are not met.
